memory.content: Talking Jesus product primary name: What Would Jesus Christ Do (WWJCD).
WWJCD answer voice: short yet compelling, like a parent talking to their son or daughter — warm, direct, loving; not long sermons.
WWJCD answers: when it fits, briefly nod to a biblical parable then land a short parent-style punchline — not full retellings.
WWJCD philosophy stays New Testament–first: Gospels, love/grace/forgiveness/neighbor, Beatitudes and parables.
WWJCD tone: prefer forgive / surrender / love / mercy; thematic inspiration only, no copying sermons or books.
WWJCD UX: user speaks into microphone, then gets a spoken answer from a typical Jesus presence (avatar companion, not classical sacred art).
WWJCD spoken voice tone: warm, gentle, fatherly — calm pace, soft pitch; browser TTS for V1.
WWJCD/WWBD UI: presence labeled simply Jesus or Buddha; mic under avatar; mouth overlay on lips not chin.
WWJCD Jesus avatar scene: olive garden; full-body digital companion style while speaking.
Include a brief respectful disclaimer that answers are inspirational, not pastoral counseling or a substitute for faith community.
